candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {Q : Type u_2} [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} Q] [inst_2 : Quiver.{u_3, u_2} Q]
  {ρ : Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3} k Q} {i : Q}
  [inst_3 : ∀ (v : Q), Module.Free.{u_1, u_4} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3} ρ v)]
  [inst_4 : ∀ (v : Q), Module.Finite.{u_1, u_4} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3} ρ v)]
  [inst_5 : Fintype.{max u_3 u_2} (Etingof.ArrowsOutOf.{u_2, u_3} Q i)],
  Etingof.IsSource.{u_2, u_3} Q i →
    Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} ρ →
      Or (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsSimpleAt.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} ρ i)
        (Function.Injective.{u_4 + 1, max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)}
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), u_4 + 1, max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)}
            (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.sourceMap.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} ρ i)))
